notes: Harriet Street jogs twice: north of Clark it runs at x ~2362 (30 ft); from Clark to Gest it runs at x ~2030 (30 ft), so there are two Harriet/Clark T's (x 2362 from the north, x 2028 from the south); south of Gest Harriet resumes at x ~1476, giving two Harriet/Gest T's. Oehler Street also jogs at Harriet: west leg (printed '(BLACKFORD) OEHLER') centres y ~2817, east leg (printed OEHLER) y ~2707. Sarah Alley is printed SARAH between Dalton and Harriet (10 ft); east of Harriet the same alley is printed 'ALLEY 2' and 15 ft, and sheet 60 names it SARAH ALLEY west of Louisa, so the whole line is Sarah Alley. Shaw Alley: the 10 ft N-S alley at x ~1126 is labelled 'SHAW' south of Oehler Alley and 'ALLEY' north of it (one label split across Oehler Alley); it runs from Sarah Alley across Clark to Oehler Street. Unnamed 10 ft E-W alley from Dalton to Harriet at y ~3228 meets Harriet 22 px north of where Espanola meets it from the east. Street names printed without suffix (HOPKINS, HARRIET, LOUISA, CARR, ESPANOLA, SARAH, SHAW); Street/Alley suffix assumed by width. President Place printed 'PRESIDENT PL.' north of Hopkins. Hopkins printed 80 ft east of Dalton. 'POCOCK' text along Harriet is the Oliver Pocock business label, not a street name. Louisa is crossed by a 2nd-storey passage of the A. Sander Co. building just north of Espanola.
